text:
The median asking rent in Bonn stands at 13.54 €/m², up 4.6 % year‑on‑year and 24.3 % over the last five years, placing the city 12th among the 37 most expensive German markets. The 25th‑percentile level is 11.92 €/m² and the 75th‑percentile 15.01 €/m², while a typical 60 m² unit costs about 812 € per month.

The market remains tight, with a vacancy rate of 1.6 % and listings staying on the market for an average of 23 days; 34 % are let within a week. Rent‑burden for two residents is 16.8 %, and asking rents carry a 49 % premium over the 2022 existing rent of 9.09 €/m².

The model estimate forecasts the median asking rent to reach 14.3 €/m² in 12 months, ranging between 13.93 €/m² and 14.64 €/m², reflecting a further 5.6 % increase.
